book.title: 独坐敬亭山
book.subtitle: 一座山，安安静静陪着我

poem.author: 李白
englishLines: All the birds have flown far away,
A lone cloud drifts off at ease.
We gaze at each other without growing tired—

appreciation.zh: 鸟儿飞远了，最后一朵云也慢慢飘走。诗人独自坐着看敬亭山，山也仿佛静静看着他。没有热闹的对话，一人一山却成了不会厌倦的朋友。
appreciation.en: Birds fly away and the last cloud drifts on. The poet sits alone with Jingting Mountain, and the mountain seems to look back. Without conversation, the two become quiet companions.

parentGuide.goal: 让孩子体验安静陪伴和独处的可能，同时分辨“我想自己待会儿”和“我被孤单留下”的不同。
parentGuide.reminder: 不要把喜欢独处说成更懂事，也不要要求孩子必须安静；如果孩子感到孤单，先提供真实陪伴，而不是只劝他像诗人一样忍耐。
questions: 鸟和云走后，什么还陪着诗人？
你什么时候喜欢自己待一会儿，什么时候更想有人陪？
安静陪伴一定要说很多话吗？
parentGuide.activity: 亲子并排看同一棵树或一座远山一分钟，可以说话也可以不说；结束后各自分享一个刚才注意到的细节和一种感受。

ageTips.age4to5: 保持时间很短，让孩子随时靠近、离开或说话。
ageTips.age6to8: 讨论主动独处、安静陪伴和被排斥三者的区别。

pages.zhText:
众鸟高飞尽，
孤云独去闲。
相看两不厌，
只有敬亭山。
pages.enText:
All the birds have flown far away,
A lone cloud drifts off at ease.
We gaze at each other without growing tired—
Only Jingting Mountain and I.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Quiet late-afternoon view of green Jingting Mountain, a gentle Tang poet sits safely on a grassy overlook, the last birds fly high away and one white cloud drifts across wide sky, companionship rather than sadness, no text.

pages.zhText:
众鸟高飞尽，
一群鸟越飞越高，越飞越远，最后变成天边的小点。
pages.enText:
All the birds have flown far away.
The flock climbs higher and farther until it becomes tiny dots.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Same seated poet watches a small flock of birds recede across an immense pale blue sky above Jingting Mountain, clear progression from near to distant birds, no fallen birds, no text.

pages.zhText:
孤云独去闲。
最后一朵白云也不着急，慢悠悠地向远处飘去。
pages.enText:
A lone cloud drifts off at ease.
The last white cloud takes its time floating away.
pages.illustrationPrompt: One soft white cloud drifts calmly over the same rounded mountain while same poet follows it with relaxed gaze, wide rice-paper negative space and gentle breeze in grass, no text.

pages.zhText:
相看两不厌，
热闹都走远了，诗人看着山，山也像在看着诗人，怎么看都不会厌倦。
pages.enText:
We gaze at each other without growing tired.
The poet looks at the mountain, and the mountain seems to look back.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Balanced face-to-mountain composition, same poet in calm profile and Jingting's welcoming rounded peak echo each other's shape across open space, natural landscape not a literal face, no text.

pages.zhText:
只有敬亭山。
此刻没有鸟群，也没有云朵，只有敬亭山稳稳地留在眼前。
pages.enText:
Only Jingting Mountain and I.
With birds and cloud gone, the mountain remains steady before him.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Clear simple scene of same poet and the solid green mountain under an almost empty sky, warm low sun touches grass, spacious but not lonely, no text.

pages.zhText: 鸟有鸟的方向，云有云的旅程，山有山的停留。诗人不追赶谁，只把目光轻轻放在还留着的山上。
pages.enText: Birds have their direction, clouds have their journey, and mountains know how to stay. The poet chases no one; he rests his gaze on what remains.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide continuous landscape showing distant birds and cloud moving toward horizon while same poet remains beside stable Jingting Mountain, visual contrast of motion and stillness, no text.

pages.zhText: 一个人安静待着，不一定就是难过；有人默默坐在身边，也是一种陪伴。如果你觉得孤单，也可以开口请喜欢的人靠近一点。
pages.enText: Quiet time alone is not always sad, and someone sitting nearby can be a form of company. If you feel lonely, you can ask a trusted person to come closer.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Same poet is joined at a respectful distance by a trusted old friend who sits quietly on another flat stone, both face the mountain with relaxed posture, no forced interaction, no text.

pages.zhText: 和大人并排看一棵树或一座远山吧。可以说话，也可以安静一分钟；然后告诉彼此，你刚刚看见了什么。
pages.enText: Sit beside a grown-up and look at one tree or a distant hill. You may talk or stay quiet for a minute, then share what each of you noticed.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Same poet and trusted friend sit side by side at safe overlook, each notices a different detail in mountain, pine and light, open supportive body language, no text.

pages.zhText:
众鸟高飞尽，
孤云独去闲。
相看两不厌，
只有敬亭山。
再轻轻读一遍吧。
pages.enText:
All the birds have flown far away,
A lone cloud drifts off at ease.
We gaze at each other without growing tired—
Only Jingting Mountain and I.
Now read it softly once more.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Closing dusk view of same poet and friend walking down the safe hillside path while Jingting Mountain remains in violet-green evening light, one first star appears, peaceful no text.

imagePromptKit.globalStyle: Playful contemporary Chinese ink-and-watercolor children's picture-book illustration on warm rice-paper texture, soft layered ink wash, mineral green and spacious pale blue with restrained violet and warm amber, elegant negative space, crisp child-friendly focal shapes, square composition.
imagePromptKit.characterConsistency: Keep the same gentle Tang poet throughout: thoughtful middle-aged face, short dark beard, black hair in a simple topknot, muted blue-gray robe, moss sash and cloth shoes; same safe grassy overlook, rounded green Jingting Mountain, pine, wide sky, receding birds and one drifting cloud; a trusted older friend appears only on pages 7–9.
